'''Craci''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EOTECR" /> located in the [[Craci system/Legends|Craci system]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> The planet was the home of the [[Cracian thumper]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] used frequently as mounts by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. Controlled by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the planet had [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] that experienced high levels of activity due to the agriculture and industry of the five worlds that were also located within the same system.<ref name="EOTECR" />
